issues: Kinetochore (yellow dot) lateral placement on the inner/center-facing side of each chromatid during anaphase (2.2s–4.2s) is geometrically inconsistent with poleward pulling: the microtubule arrives from the outer pole, so the attachment site should face the pole. Interpreted as a schematic simplification (dot marks centromere locus); not a blocking error because the microtubule–chromatid connection and correct poleward direction are unambiguous.

Prometaphase dynamic attachment/orientation is not shown as a process; the video opens in the already-aligned, already-attached metaphase state. Acceptable for a 5 s schematic but noted as a scope-coverage gap.
Chromatid shapes are flat vertical bars rather than the V/rod morphology typical of anaphase; acceptable as a deliberate schematic simplification.
No labels present (intentional per scope); no invented text detected.

scope_review: Model scope is a single duplicated chromosome (one sister-chromatid pair) in a eukaryotic cell, covering prometaphase attachment, metaphase alignment, and anaphase separation. The video instantiates exactly this scope: one pink duplex → two daughter chromatids, two poles, one metaphase plate, two kinetochore microtubules. Excluded processes (cohesin cleavage, cytokinesis, nuclear envelope dynamics, checkpoint) are absent, as required. The deliberate single-chromosome scope is respected; no demand for molecular cleavage is made.

visible_evidence.observation: Video Observed: Pink X-shaped duplicated chromosome (two sister chromatids joined at centromere) centered on the vertical metaphase-plate line. Two yellow kinetochore dots at the centromeric region. Two horizontal microtubule lines extend from left and right blue poles to the kinetochores. Bipolar orientation and metaphase alignment confirmed.

Video Observed: The joined pair has split into two distinct vertical pink bars with a visible gap at the former centromere. Each bar carries one yellow kinetochore dot. Microtubules remain connected from each pole. Early anaphase separation confirmed.

Video Observed: Left chromatid has crossed to the left of the metaphase-plate line; right chromatid to the right. Each moves toward its respective pole. Microtubule segments have shortened compared to 0.2 s, consistent with anaphase-A depolymerization. Poleward direction correct.

Video Observed: Continued poleward migration; chromatids approximately midway between metaphase plate and poles. Identity of the two daughter chromatids is continuous from prior frames (same color, shape, kinetochore). No new objects appear.

Video Observed: Chromatids have approached their respective poles. Microtubule segments are at their shortest. All objects remain within frame bounds. No text, no extraneous entities. Final state consistent with late anaphase.
